# iosxe_wireless_rf_tag (Resource)

This resource can manage the Wireless RF Tag configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "iosxe_wireless_rf_tag" "example" {
  name            = "S1-RF-Tag-Test"
  description     = "Test RF Tag"
  rf_policy_24ghz = "default_rf_24gh"
  rf_policy_5ghz  = "default_rf_5gh"
  rf_policy_6ghz  = "default-rf-profile-6ghz"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Configure the rf tag name

### Optional

- `description` (String) Configure the brief description about the rf tag.
- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.
- `rf_policy_24ghz` (String) Configure the 802.11b Radio-Frequency(rf)-profile that is associated with this rf tag
- `rf_policy_5ghz` (String) Configure the 802.11a Radio-Frequency(rf)-profile that is associated with this rf tag
- `rf_policy_6ghz` (String) 802.11 6GHz Radio-Frequency(rf)-profile that is associated with this RF tag

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The path of the object.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import iosxe_wireless_rf_tag.example "<name>"
```
